title: UI窗口管理缺乏便利功能
description: UI窗口管理缺乏便利功能，无法停靠、调整窗口大小或追踪窗口归属。
evidence: It would also be nice to have some settings to the UI like docking the windows somewhere, making them smaller or larger, etc.
I do wish for a more QoL regarding window placement and tracking which window belongs to which container
